fact: The DGI portal describes eTAX as a web platform for tele-registration, tele-declaration and tele-payment of taxes, and its events log dates the launch of tele-declaration to 30 January 2023.
The DGI portal says eTAX lets taxpayers make tele-payment of taxes, launched 30 January 2023, with a printable payment receipt tutorial.
The Director General of Taxes said that through E-Tax, launched in 2022, taxpayers can declare their taxes online.
The Director General of Taxes said that through E-Tax taxpayers can pay their taxes online, with banks and mobile operators facilitating electronic payments.
The DGI says E-Tax is a platform for online registration, filing (teledeclaration) and payment, where returns, payment orders and receipts can be issued and downloaded online.
The DGI says E-Tax allows taxpayers to pay online all taxes they owe, and it is interconnected with eight banks.
FurtherAfrica says Chad's eTax system covers electronic filing, with a pilot rolled out to businesses.
